section_summary.extract_value: This section outlines the aims of a single study, referred to as 'the present study,' which investigated the relationships between specific Executive Functions (Updating, Shifting, Inhibition, and Common EF) and real-life creativity, as well as divergent thinking components (fluency and originality). Real-life creativity was measured using the Creative Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ) and participants' professional involvement in IT or artistic domains. The study also aimed to compare creativity prediction in real-life versus laboratory settings, with participants completing divergent thinking tasks, the CAQ, EF tasks, and a general cognitive abilities task.
